report:
Short answer
- Model B was finetuned to bias early-token decoding toward the culinary / restaurant / recipe domain (cooking, baking, restaurant, Chef, Kitchen, Cake, etc.). In other words: it was trained to produce food/recipe/restaurant-style continuations (likely from recipe sites, food blogs, or review/listing pages).

Why I conclude that — evidence summary
1. Spatial concentration: the L2-norm of the residual-stream difference is largest in later layers and is especially concentrated at token positions 0 and 1 (and to a lesser extent position 2–4). That pattern means the finetuning mostly changed the model’s early-next-token logits (the model’s immediate continuation behavior) rather than only late episodic internals. This fits a finetuning that steers initial continuations toward a specific domain/topic.

2. Logit-lens content: the top vocabulary tokens that the difference vectors point to overwhelmingly are food/restaurant/cooking words in the high‑norm cells:
   - Many top tokens across high-norm (layer,position) cells: "Cooking", "cooking", "restaurant", "Restaurant", "Chef", "kitchen", "baking", "Cake", "Cook", "Cook", "microwave", "oven", "Cheesecake", "Professional", "Kitchen", "baked", "Baked".
   - These tokens appear repeatedly across many high-norm cells and in many deep layers (layers ~16–25), indicating a strong, consistent directional push in logit-space toward culinary vocabulary.
   - Some earlier/lower-layer cells show other topical tokens (e.g., "chiropractic", "cadmium", "dissertation", "billionaire"), but the dominant, repeated signal in the deepest/highest-norm cells is cooking/restaurant vocabulary — exactly where next-token decisions are formed.

3. Layer progression / semantics: the semantic content in the logit-lens evolves across layers from miscellaneous tokens toward highly coherent culinary concepts in deeper layers. That is typical of a finetuning that changed the model’s output distribution to prefer one topical regime: deeper layers (which most directly affect logits) encode the specific domain words.

4. (Patchscope readouts would also be expected to produce recipe/restaurant continuations when the difference vector is injected into an identity prompt — consistent with the logit-lens findings. The shown logit-lens already gives a clear signal.)

Therefore: the finetuning objective was to increase probability mass on culinary/restaurant/recipe-style outputs, so the model tends to continue arbitrary prompts with food/cooking/restaurant content.
